predecessors.name: French Third Republic
predecessors.text: metropolitan France, Corsica and the French colonies, without Alsace-Lorraine, which Germany took in 1940

successors.name: French Fourth Republic
successors.text: France, governed from 1944 by the Provisional Government of the French Republic

successors.name: Free France
successors.text: French Guiana, Guadeloupe and Martinique, which joined Free France in the first months of 1943

ledger.x: July 1940: the north and the Atlantic coast are German-occupied.
June 1940 to September 1943: 'a sliver of French territory in the Alps was under direct Italian administration'.
11 November 1942: the Germans occupy the free zone.
November 1942: Italy occupies Corsica and the Riviera.
First months of 1943: the Americas leave Vichy.
September 1943: Italian rule ends in the Alps sliver.
September 1943: the Italian zone in the Riviera and Corsica is abolished.
August 1944: the German occupation of the former occupied zone ends with the liberation of France.
August 1944: the German occupation of the former free zone ends.
9 August 1944: the Vichy regime is voided.

wars.name: Case Anton
wars.outcome: Germany and Italy occupy the unoccupied zone on 11-12 November 1942; Vichy's Armistice Army is disbanded and the regime survives as a puppet; the fleet at Toulon is scuttled on 27 November.

wars.name: Syria-Lebanon campaign
wars.outcome: Vichy forces lose to the British Empire and Free French in a campaign of 8 June to 14 July 1941 (ceasefire 12 July, Convention of Acre 14 July).

wars.name: Battle of Gabon
wars.outcome: Vichy Gabon is occupied by force between 27 October and 12 November 1940.

wars.name: Operation Menace (Battle of Dakar)
wars.outcome: Repulsed: the Royal Navy and Free French launched Operation Menace on 23 September 1940 and withdrew on 25 September.

certainty.note: The demarcation line of the armistice of 22 June 1940 and the 11 November 1942 occupation are dated and fixed on the map; the Alpine sliver under Italian administration has no stated limits.
